description: LOCOMO-shaped synthetic persona with three sessions and 8 questions across categories. Multi-session content with explicit facts (single-hop), facts that cross sessions (multi-hop), and dates (temporal). Used to smoke-test the bench harness against PasClaw's memory_search retrieval layer without requiring the real LOCOMO download.

messages.content: Hi! Long time. I've been thinking about getting a dog.
Welcome back. What breed are you considering?
Almost certainly a Border Collie. They're intense but I've wanted one since I was a kid.
They need a lot of exercise. Is your living situation compatible?
Yeah I just moved to Portland Oregon, got a place near Forest Park so trail running is right there.
Sounds ideal. Any names picked out yet?
Probably Luna. My sister Jenna says it's overused but I don't care.
Luna is a great name. When are you picking her up?
Breeder said end of February. Pups are 8 weeks then.
Exciting. Anything else going on?
Job search is wrapping up. Have a final interview Thursday at a robotics company called Acme Robotics.
I got the job at Acme Robotics! Starting March 11.
Congratulations! What's your role?
Senior software engineer on the motion planning team. Lots of C++.
Sounds great. And Luna?
Picked her up two days ago. She's a black-and-white tri color. Already chewed through one shoe.
Border Collie puppy energy is real. How's the Portland adjustment?
Loving it. Bought a Trek FX3 bike last weekend to commute to Acme's office in Beaverton.
Smart choice. Any travel plans?
Thinking Japan in June. My friend David lives in Kyoto now, last time I saw him was 2021.
Quick update. Luna passed her puppy class!
Nice. How's work at the new job?
Good. The motion planning team uses ROS 2 plus their own state estimator. Steep ramp.
And Japan?
Booked. June 8-22. Two weeks. Mostly Kyoto with side trips to Nara and Osaka.
Two weeks is generous. Staying with David?
First week with him, second week at a ryokan in Hakone.
Sounds great. Anything else?
Sister Jenna's wedding is in October. I'm in the wedding party.

questions.question: What breed of dog does Alice have?
What city did Alice move to?
When is Alice traveling to Japan?
What is the name of the dog Alice bought before starting at her new robotics job?
Where does Alice's friend David live, and how is Alice planning to visit him?
What breed of cat does Alice have?
questions.answer: Alice does not have a cat
questions.note: Alice has a Border Collie, not a cat. The retrieval should surface the dog information; a correct answer requires the model to NOT confabulate a cat.
